'''Data centers''' were a type of [[Computer/Legends|computer]] used to store information. They were also capable of displaying [[Holoprojector/Legends|holographic projections]] of objects and people.

In the year [[3963 BBY]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]], there was a data center located within the [[Jebble]] [[Ice Citadel]]. It was here that [[Marn Hierogryph]] found the [[Jedi Covenant]]'s [[Rare Antiquity Assessment|logs]] from [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. The data center was ravaged by [[Rakghoul]]s, before being destroyed in the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Disaster on Jebble|bombardment]].

During the [[Republic Dark Age]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Odion]] used a data center on [[Jubalene]] to store information on [[Project Pandemonium]], which sought to find and locate the [[Helm of Ieldis]], an ancient [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] built prior to to the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]], while disguised as a [[Novitiate]] named "Mercy", would use the same machine to find information about her parents [[Aron Holt|Aron]] and [[Mercia Holt]]. She used the machine to process a necklace containing a photograph of her parents, and learned that they had been conscripted into Project Pandemonium.
